NO - noncitizens should not be eligible to vote in ANY American election at any level of government.

This shouldn't be hard. Or partisan.


Matt Van Swol (@mattvanswol)

A simple yes or no: "Should noncitizens be able to vote?"

Spencer Pratt: No
Karen Bass: It depends 
Nithya Raman: It depends

Spencer Pratt is the only adult in this conversation.

Video

I hope every journalist in America embraces the Nick Shirley era and starts knocking on doors to just ask the simple questions.

This is SHOCKING.


Luke Rosiak (@lukerosiak)

You've heard about this story. Now you get to see it.

I traveled to Columbus, Ohio, and witnessed the most egregious government waste I've seen in my 20 years as an investigative reporter.

This has been going on for years, and you've been paying for it.

Take a look⬇️

Video

While filling in for @PressSec, @marcorubio answers a powerful question: "What is your hope for America at a time such as this?"

His answer blew me away.

Video

Between 2020 and 2024, young female voters shifted 11 points away from the Democrat Party and toward the Republican Party. In one election cycle.

Don't despair and discount young women just yet.


Brittany Hugoboom (@BritHugoboom)

People are using this chart to say that “women are becoming more liberal.” 

However, it’s worth noticing the significant drop post 2020.

How much of this is happening in our country right in front of our faces??


Luke Rosiak (@lukerosiak)

94 Medicaid "home health" companies purport to occupy this office building, taking more than $66 million of your money. They provide free butlers to immigrants.

"No windows on the outside hides the fact that there's no one on the inside." There's an entire street of these.

The back of her shirt *literally* says “do unto others as you would have them do unto you.”

The proclivity for violence toward conservatives in our society is completely off the rails.


End Wokeness (@EndWokeness)

She's wearing shirt about "kindness" as she does this. You can't make it up.

Video

isha (@MibshaD)

If abortion is "playing God," so is chemo, insulin, and C-sections. Funny how only women's medical choices get called sacrilegious.



— https://nitter.net/MibshaD/status/2050770484321755142#m

& just like that our little girl is One Big Beautiful Baby!!

Grateful beyond words for Isla lighting up our lives this year - you are everything to us, sweet girl! 🫶 what a weekend celebrating with our friends & family who’ve supported us in immeasurable ways this first year as parents… we love you guys!

Imagine if this man actually fabricated "I bet your fish head wife doesn't have these cannons" as an insult against YOUR OWN WIFE in a made up sexual harassment suit 🤡

Do you think the JP Morgan lawsuit is fabricated??

Video

This is the most wholesome thing I've ever seen


CatholicVote (@CatholicVote)

This is incredible.

A 10-year-old boy shares that he wants to be a priest when he grows up, citing a call God has put on his heart:

"Why have you decided you want to be a priest?"

"Because God's calling me."

Beautiful 🥹

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/CatholicVote/status/2049492752937763125#m
This is beyond disgusting, and needs to change TODAY.
The medical field is operating in a serious double standard, and it’s got to stop.

Is this elder abuse??? 🧐

Hey so maybe just read a book!!#greenscreen
Bring back eyebrow furrows por favor
Being pregnant is not a death sentence - it’s one of the best things that could ever happen in your life as a a woman. Full interview dropping Friday 🫶
Literally what is the Senate doing atp

maybe slowing down is the whole point. even though you all warned me that “the days are long, but the years are short,” this first year with my baby girl evaporated in the blink of an eye… what I wouldn’t give for one more newborn snuggle, hearing her laugh like this for the first time, seeing the light in her eyes as she takes her first steps, and her needing to hold my hand for just a little bit longer. there is truly nothing more beautiful in my life than being your mama, sweet girl 🤍
